changes.to: Maker exhibit entry (WRC 2026, Hangzhou iSoftStone Tianqing Robot Technology, an iSoftStone spin-out): the A2 line covers an interaction version (public-space service with multimodal interaction and autonomous navigation) and a work version (a general mobile service platform with standard development interfaces for single and fleet applications); the S, A and T series cover biped and wheeled semi-humanoid robots. The entry publishes no numbers. Third-party catalogue figures (162 cm, 20 DoF, 7-DoF arms) were not filled.
iSoftStone Tianqing's A2 wheeled service and industrial humanoid, offered in an interaction version and a work version.
